import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    private static final int MAXN = 1000000007;
    
    private static long fastExpPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * base) % mod;
            }
            exp >>= 1;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int P = scanner.nextInt();
        int K = scanner.nextInt();
        
        int[] parent = new int[P + 1];
        int[] rank = new int[P + 1];
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= P; i++) {
            parent[i] = i;
            rank[i] = 1;
        }
        
        Set<Integer> groups = new HashSet<>();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= P; i++) {
            long value = ((long)K * (long)i) % P;
            int pa = findParent(parent, i);
            int pb = findParent(parent, (int)value);
            
            if (pa != pb) {
                union(parent, rank, pa, pb);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= P; i++) {
            groups.add(findParent(parent, i));
        }
        
        long ways;
        if (K == 0) {
            ways = fastExpPow((long)P, (long)(P - 1), (long)MAXN);
        } else if (K == 1) {
            ways = fastExpPow((long)P, (long)P, (long)MAXN);
        } else {
            ways = fastExpPow((long)P, (long)groups.size(), (long)MAXN);
        }
        
        System.out.println(ways);
    }
    
    private static int findParent(int[] parent, int nd) {
        if (parent[nd] != nd) {
            parent[nd] = findParent(parent, parent[nd]);
        }
        return parent[nd];
    }
    
    private static void union(int[] parent, int[] rank, int nd1, int nd2) {
        if (rank[nd1] >= rank[nd2]) {
            parent[nd2] = nd1;
            rank[nd1]++;
        } else {
            parent[nd1] = nd2;
            rank[nd2]++;
        }
    }
}
